title: Python attribute-write one-path read-side: #7 #13 #14 #1 #12 and the gated-MRO machinery (DEC-303 a86 item 2 fallback from GCLI-155)
description: Held task carved out of opum-ai/glyph-cli#238 (GCLI-155, 151b) by the DEC-303 (a86) item 2 fallback, which is pre-agreed and is a cut, not a patch. Round 2 at 2b3a2ba blocked on R1: a base name bound more than once at module scope, with a write to it, creates in-repo edges and drops POLY flags against origin/dev c733627. Shapes held here: #7 (a written class name in a base position), #13 (classSymbolOfName from-import reads), #14 (the class-attribute decorator arm and its own write-set collection), #1 (the module-scope gate in resolveBareName at 2649) and #12 (the star-resolution gate), plus all machinery that existed only for them: the gated mark on the merged C3 MRO, the gated checks in methodLookup/firstMethodEntry/instanceClassOf, the collectAttributeWrites all-gates-off bypass, and the decorator-side collectAttributeWrites call. | R1 EVIDENCE (measured on origin/dev c733627 and 2b3a2ba, fresh git-archive trees): same-module try/except double binding - dev 2 edges, bins 2/0/1/0, poly=2, k.m() refused; head 3 edges, bins 3/0/0/0, poly=0, with a CREATED call m.py:9:13 -> m.py:B.m and both surviving edges losing POLY. if/else double class B - dev 4 edges 4/0/2/0 poly=4; head 6 edges 6/0/0/0 poly=0, two CREATED k.m edges and four POLY drops. Star importer via `from m import *` - dev 2 edges 2/0/1/0 poly=2; head 3 edges 3/0/0/0 poly=0, one CREATED k.m edge. The attr-arm control (class D(m.B) in another file) is dev-equal on head. Without-write twins are dev-equal in all three. | R2-R5 (measured, non-blocking): R2 the __new__ constructorNote is lost on head (dev [{file app.py, line 5, reasons [__new__]}], head []); R3 the local construction inside a written module is REFUSED on head, a removal only, while x.m() and h() keep C.m; R4 an opaque bare base moves the external bin to the receiver bin; R5 no created edge in either C3 order (the two Inner.f calls are removed). | EXEMPTION ATTEMPT (measured in a scratch copy, not taken): exempting only the 2649 gate, via an optional parameter passed only from the multiply fallback in baseAlternatives, makes the same-module try/except and if/else variants byte-for-byte dev-equal but leaves the star-importer variant with its CREATED k.m edge, because that path does not reach the 2649 gate. The fallback is a cut, so this was not taken; it is recorded here as evidence if a later ruling wants the narrower fix. | CONSTRAINTS that bind this task: DEC-303 (a80) item 1 B1/B1b and (a86) item 1 - build the MRO write-blind as dev does, refuse at lookup when the path crosses a gated base, never fall through to the next base, and collect writes with all three gates off; removal-only, no created in-repo edge; two rounds of its own under DEC-161 and no third; the (a86) item 2 fallback terms apply again if a round blocks. GCLI-151b terms: every new shape gets a neighbour and receiver read fixture, the proof states its group count and fails rather than passes if it reads fewer groups, and removed edges are named in the PR. | The R1 fixtures are already in the #238 tree, rewritten to pin dev outcome; build on them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of #1, #7, #12, #13 and #14 names its opum-doc ruling or measurement ruling before it is built

Each built shape has a red-before green-after refused fixture with a resolving twin, the R1 three-variant fixtures (same-module try/except, if/else, star importer) are in the proof, and a mutant per path is observed red

Removal-only holds: the flag-extended subset check over the five pins, every fixture and the corpus shows no created and no flag-changed in-repo edge, with an observed-red control and a group floor; every removed edge is named in the PR

The gated-MRO machinery (mark on the merged C3, checks in methodLookup/firstMethodEntry/instanceClassOf, collectAttributeWrites bypass, decorator collection call) is restored only with the shapes that need it, and the R2-R5 outcomes are re-measured
No DEC-182 path class is touched and no dependency is added

plan: 1. Restore the DEC-303 (a86) item 1 machinery from the 2b3a2ba round-2 tree: MroEntry.gated, baseGated, the mark applied to the merged C3, the stops in firstMethodEntry/methodLookup/instanceClassOf, collectAttributeWrites with all gates off, and the decorator-side collection call.

2. Close R1 by construction: every base-RELATION path (baseAlternatives, the children map, effectiveMetaclass) resolves write-blind, so a doubly-bound written base keeps its alternatives; only the gated marking and the lookup consumers read the gates.

3. Restore the shapes that need the machinery: #7 (a written class name in a base position), #13 (classSymbolOfName from-import reads), #14 (the class-attribute decorator arm), #1 (the module-scope gate in resolveBareName) and #12 (the star-resolution gate); re-measure R2-R5.

4. Fixtures from the start: the R1 three variants (try/except, if/else, star importer) plus the attr-arm control and the without-write twins; a red-before green-after refused fixture with a resolving twin per shape; one mutant per path observed red.

5. Proof: the flag-extended subset check over the five pins, every fixture and the corpus, with the group count stated, a floor that fails on a short read and an observed-red control; every removed edge named in the PR.
implementationNotes: RULINGS NAMED BEFORE BUILD (AC1), each read from ODOC-640 by this session and confirmed first-hand: #1 = DEC-303 (a79) Q-B and (a80) item 3 N2 (the defining module's own bare read and the star importer's); #7 = (a80) B1 (a written class name in a base position); #12 = (a80) item 3 N2 (star importer bare f); #13 = (a80) item 3 N3 (classSymbolOfName with from m import C); #14 = (a80) item 3 N4 (a decorator @C.m after C.m = other). Construction and proof per (a86) items 1 and 3, relayed by the leader from opum-doc's 11:44:04Z note. CONSTRUCTION (a86 item 1): the MRO is built write-blind as dev builds it, a base whose name a recorded write rebinds is marked gated on the MERGED C3 (never dropped), lookups refuse without falling through, and the write sets are collected with all gates off. RESTORED from the 2b3a2ba round-2 tree: MroEntry.gated, baseGated, the merged-C3 marking, the stops in firstMethodEntry/methodLookup/instanceClassOf, the collectAttributeWrites all-gates-off bypass and the decorator-side collection call. THE R1 FIX IS THE ONE NEW PIECE: baseAlternatives, the children map's only base-relation reader, now runs its whole enumeration inside withoutAttributeGate, because round 2 read the head name and the module chain there with the gates on and a doubly-bound written base came back unresolved instead of multiply.

PROOF (AC2/AC3), run 2026-11-27 on this branch against dev d58878f, trees built by git archive, five pins at the corpus already extracted (flask httpx jinja rich tqdm): 1483 groups checked against a floor of 1466 (5 pins + 1394 corpus sources + 84 fixtures); dev 17546 edges, head 17516; 0 CREATED edges, 0 flag-changed; 30 removed edges and 16 bin changes, ALL inside fixtures, NO pin moved (flask 1366, httpx 2791, jinja 2833, rich 7410, tqdm 981 on both sides), no corpus source moved. CONTROLS in the same harness: --control injected one created edge into a pin and one into a fixture and both were REPORTED; --floor-control (unreachable floor 1e6) FAILED at 1483 groups read, so the check refuses on a short read; the constructorNotes comparator's --control detected the injected note. MUTANTS, 16 of them, every one observed red: M1 #1 module-scope gate (3 red, incl. #12), M2 reader check, M3 baseGated marking (10), M4 super first arg, M5 enclosing fallback, M6 #13 (1), M7 #14 decorator arm, M8 decorator collection, M9 init write (kept path), M10 instanceClassOf gated (1), M11 methodLookup gated (5), M12 firstMethodEntry gated (3), M13 all-gates-off collection (85), M14 #14 bypass-awareness, M15 #12 module-binding gate (6), M16 THE R1 FIX (exactly 1 red, the R1 fixture). M16 reproduces the round-2 block verbatim when removed: a CREATED m.py:9:13 -> m.py:B.m edge and both POLY flags dropped.

R2-R5 RE-MEASURED (AC4), all removal-only, none blocking: R2 the __new__ constructorNote is lost again (one group: R2r2 new written; dev [{file app.py, line 5, reasons [__new__]}], head []), which is the fail-closed reading instanceClassOf must take past a gated base under (a86) item 1, and it is a note, not an edge; R3 the local construction inside a written module is removed (R3r2 local written: m.py:5:9 -> m.py:C gone, bin inRepo->nameNotBound); R4 an opaque bare base moves the external bin to the receiver bin (R4r2 bare base written: resolvedExternal -> receiverNeedsInference); R5 no created edge in either C3 order (R5r2 subFirst and dFirst both only remove, and move inRepo->receiver). GATED MACHINERY IS RESTORED ONLY WITH THE SHAPES THAT NEED IT (AC4): the marking, the three lookup stops and the all-gates-off collection are each reddened by their own mutant and green on the kept-path mutants M2/M4/M5/M9/M14. INTEGRITY: bun run check exits 0 (1353 tests pass, 0 fail; format:check green; the one lint warning is the pre-existing calls.ts useConst). The R1 three-variant fixture (try/except, if/else, star importer) plus the attr-arm control and the three without-write twins are in test/python-hops.test.ts and green, and the same shapes ride the subset check as R1r2 try/if/star plus the attr control.

DEC-303 (a89) FIX COMMIT on opum-ai/glyph-cli#242 (round 2 is the last under DEC-161). F1 and F2 were REPRODUCED on 034a898a before anything was changed, dev vs head: F1 dev gives no edges, receiverNeedsInference 1 with reason rebound-base at x.py:4:9; head gives no edges, resolvedExternal 1 and no receiver reason. F2 dev emits E().m() -> Outer.Inner.m in BOTH base orders (2 in-repo edges); head matches dev in the F-first order and refuses in the D-first order, so the answer depended on base order. FIXES, one commit: F1 wraps baseIsRebound's body in withoutAttributeGate as baseAlternatives already is, so the second base-RELATION reader is write-blind and the written head module name bins receiver/rebound-base again; F2 marks every key gated in ANY base's own MRO, not only the keys of a base this class itself finds gated, so c3merge's first-reached shared entry can no longer decide the answer. F3 adds the (a83) item 2 reads to the R1 family as its own fixture: the neighbour attribute m.nn() and the written m.B across the write, before and after, both sides agreeing and both dev's. NAMED REMOVAL: F2 removes the dev edge E().m() -> Outer.Inner.m in BOTH orders, which is the order-dependence being corrected and a wrong edge on dev. NEW MUTANTS M17 (F1's wrap) and M18 (F2's any-base mark) are each observed red on exactly their own fixture. PROOF re-run on the fixed tree: 1490 groups against a floor of 1490 (5 pins + 1394 corpus sources + 91 fixtures), 0 created, 0 flag-changed, 32 removed edges and 17 bin changes all inside fixtures, every pin unmoved, --control reports both injected edges, --floor-control fails, constructorNotes equal except the one re-measured R2r2 note; bun run check exits 0 with 1356 tests.
finalSummary: Delivered in opum-ai/glyph-cli#242 at commit d876a3d, where the proof below ran: the gated-MRO read-side machinery is restored under DEC-303 (a86) item 1 and the five held shapes (#1 a79 Q-B / a80 N2, #7 a80 B1, #12 a80 N2, #13 a80 N3, #14 a80 N4) are built with it. R1 is closed by construction: baseAlternatives, the only base-relation reader, now enumerates with every gate off, so a doubly-bound written base keeps both alternatives and creates no edge. Proof at d876a3d: flag-extended subset check over 1483 groups (floor 1466, 0 created, 0 flag-changed, 30 removed edges and 16 bin changes, all inside fixtures, five pins and every corpus source unmoved), observed-red and floor controls both firing, constructorNotes equal except the one re-measured fail-closed __new__ note, and 16 mutants each observed red (M16, the R1 fix, exactly one). All five acceptance criteria checked with that evidence; bun run check exits 0 (1353 tests); no DEC-182 path class and no dependency touched.
